input: Price out solar panel installation for the roof

gold.taskTitle: Price Out Solar Panel Installation for Your Roof
gold.taskDescription: Research and gather accurate cost estimates for installing solar panels on the user's roof.

questions.title: What is the approximate square footage of your roof?
questions.description: Understanding roof size helps determine how many panels fit and the scale of the installation.

questions.title: Do you own the home or is it a rental?
questions.description: Ownership status determines whether the user has authority to install solar and affects financing options.

questions.title: What is your average monthly electricity bill?
questions.description: Current energy usage determines the system size needed to offset costs effectively.

questions.title: Are you looking to buy, lease, or finance the system?
questions.description: The payment method significantly changes upfront costs, long-term savings, and which providers to contact.

questions.title: What city and state is the property located in?
questions.description: Location affects installer availability, local incentives, utility net metering policies, and sunlight hours.

questions.title: Have you already received any quotes from installers?
questions.description: Knowing whether quotes exist helps avoid duplicating work and establishes a baseline for comparison.

questions.title: Is your roof due for replacement in the next few years?
questions.description: Roof condition and lifespan directly affect the timing and total cost of a solar installation.
